scope: Sample-index versus emitted frame-start timestamps; software timeline only, not physical device synchrony

expected: frame i starts at i*int(sample_rate*hop_ms/1000) samples

rounds: All21 short configurations plus one fixed120second case, no experiment wall-clock cutoff
baseline_equality: Legacy time equality is deliberately replaced where nominal hop differs from integer sample hop. Preserve spectral/mouth/energy fields and integral-hop time. Do not silently reinterpret cycle06 exact-output gate as absolute clock correctness.
